content: HackMD positioning (2026-04/05 blog): governance layer for agent-generated markdown — rendered review surface, paragraph citations, guided comments against specific sentences, versioning, human judgment gate before content enters source of truth. Framing: markdown is now the instruction set for AI behavior, so review step is non-optional. Team/cloud product; no comment-to-agent structured feedback loop back into coding agents, no bilingual layer, no cross-repo contract subscription.
